name: goose
label: Goose
description: An open-source AI developer agent by Block (CLI — Beta)

check_ready.not_ready_message: Goose CLI not found. Install it: openagents install goose — then set a provider/model (or run `goose configure` once).

env_config.name: GOOSE_PROVIDER
env_config.description: Goose provider id (e.g. openai, anthropic, google, openrouter, ollama). Leave blank to reuse your existing Goose config.

env_config.name: GOOSE_MODEL
env_config.description: Model name for the selected provider (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-6). Leave blank to reuse your existing Goose config.

env_config.name: GOOSE_PROVIDER__API_KEY
env_config.description: Provider API key (generic Goose provider key). Leave blank to reuse the Goose keyring/config, an OAuth provider, or a local provider.

env_config.name: GOOSE_PROVIDER__HOST
env_config.description: Custom provider endpoint/host URL (optional — for proxies or self-hosted/OpenAI-compatible endpoints).

env_config.name: GOOSE_MODE
env_config.description: Headless tool-permission mode. 'auto' runs tools without approval (required for the workspace); 'chat' disables tools. Approval modes are coerced to 'auto'.
